title: Tumble and the Teeny-Tiny Door
moral: Big or small, you are just right being you.
description: Tumble the baby elephant bonks his head on Pip's teeny-tiny door and wishes he were small! But when Nana Hoot's giant pumpkin and a very small hole need help, Tumble and Pip find out something special. Learn BIG and small in this funny animated story about being yourself, for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Tumble and the Teeny-Tiny Door!

narration.text: Hi friends! Guess what? Today Pip the fox was having a tea party at his little house!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble! Come in, come in! Super-duper!
Stomp, stomp, stomp! Here came Tumble the baby elephant.
He walked right up to Pip's teeny round door, and...
BONK! HONK! Oopsie-trunk! His head was too BIG for the door!
Tumble is BIG.
And the door is small. Teeny-tiny small!

narration.text: So they had the party outside. Tumble sat on a tiny chair... BOING! It bounced him right off!
He sipped from a tiny teacup... SLUUURP! The whole cup went up his trunk!
And then... AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO! Whoosh! Pip's napkins flew away like birds!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oh no. Everything is too small for me. I wish I was small like you, Pip.

narration.text: Hmm... that daisy is BIG, and the sunflower is small!
Wait a minute, Pip! Is that right? Which one is BIG, the daisy or the sunflower?
The sunflower! It is BIG and tall! You're so smart!
And the daisy is small. Pip giggled. Oopsie, he mixed them up!

narration.text: Just then, Nana Hoot fluttered down. Her glasses slipped to the tip of her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! My BIG pumpkin must go to the Harvest Fair today. Can you help?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I can! Hnnnngh! Pushhhh!
Pip pushed... and slipped. He pushed again... and slipped again! Wibble-wobble!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Let me try. Heave-ho!
Tumble gave one big push, and the pumpkin rolled along. Roll, roll, roll!

popups.sub: who fits in the small hole?

narration.text: Uh-oh! On the way, Nana's glasses slipped right off... plink... into a small hole in a log!
Tumble poked his trunk in. HONK! Only the tip would fit!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! The hole is too small for me.
Who can fit in the small hole, big Tumble or small Pip?
Small Pip! Yes! Pip is just the right size!
Zip! In went Pip, and out he came... wearing Nana's glasses on his own nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Look! I'm Nana Pip! Hoo-hoo!
At the Harvest Fair, the judges looked and looked... drumroll please!
Nana's pumpkin won a ribbon for Biggest Pumpkin! Hooray!
There's another pumpkin on the stage. Is it BIG or small?
Small! And it won a ribbon too, for Cutest Pumpkin!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: You see? Big or small, everyone is special.
On the way home, Pip whispered a secret.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble, sometimes I wish I was BIG like you!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Really? But I wished I was small like you!
They looked at each other... and laughed and laughed!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I'm big, and you're small, and we're BOTH just right! BOING!
